substeps.instruction: Use Aqua Culture system from Ontario, Canada
Start system in January 2018
Establish static aquaculture type
Set up 4 systems with total volume of 80L
Use standard tank size of 10 gallons
Use clear tank color and black tank lid color
Use glass divided with nylon mesh for component materials
Install sponge filters from Aquarium Technology, Inc., Decatur, GA for solids filtration
Perform 90% water exchange rate in tank once per week
Set photoperiod to 14H light and 10H dark

steps.title: Feed rotifers to larvae
steps.instruction:
2018 ENVIRONMENTAL SUMMARY: ALL
NUTRITION AND FEEDING
• Feed: Rotifers, Type L (Brachionus plicatilis)
• Size: ~160 µm
• Age of Application: < 21 dpf
• Feed Frequency: constant availability 5-8 dpf; fed once per day 8-21 dpf
• Amount/Feeding: polyculture of ~250 rotifers per ml from 5-8 dpf; ~1,000 rotifers per fish 8-
21 dpf

substeps.instruction: Use Type L rotifers (Brachionus plicatilis) ~160 µm in size.
Apply feeding to larvae younger than 21 dpf.
Provide constant rotifer availability from 5–8 dpf; thereafter feed once daily from 8–21 dpf.
Supply ~250 rotifers per mL in polyculture from 5–8 dpf; then ~1,000 rotifers per fish from 8–21 dpf.
